quotes.author: Grace Goebel
quotes.text: We had a wonderful experience with Tribeca Sailing! Captain David was great and made the trip so enjoyable. We did the sunset sail and absolutely loved watching the city transition from daylight to nighttime. They were so thoughtful about making sure we were comfortable, providing blankets since it gets chilly on the water this time of year. Would definitely do this again and highly recommend to anyone looking for a unique way to see the city!

quotes.author: Daniel M
quotes.text: I 100% recommend this to anyone looking for a charming sailing experience on a special occasion. I proposed to my girlfriend (now fiancée) during the ride, and it couldn’t have been more perfect. Captain David was incredibly friendly and even helped me pull off a secret surprise plan. We had an amazing time on the boat - UNFORGETTABLE! See you Captain, will be back :)

quotes.author: Doug Kelly
quotes.text: David was a fantastic captain for our afternoon trip. We booked one hour out and he was still there, ready to go when we arrived. He was very knowledgeable on the tour and gave us a great restaurant recommendation for afterwards. Would definitely go out with Captain David at Tribeca again.

quotes.author: Braulio Mogrovejo
quotes.text: One of the best experiences I have had in NYC. 100% worth it, Captain David is the best!

quotes.author: Linda Bonadies
quotes.text: What an awesome adventure! Capt Clark was superb! I highly recommend this to everyone!
